messages.subject: Multiple samples in multiple combinations to get DMR
parts:
Hello,

I have 12 samples each having 2 biological replicates. I want to find DMRs with different combinations . So can all these samples together?
If not, then do I have to change this below step according to what sample I am considering as control and treament?

Or I can use the output files(text files) of this below step in different combinations to get DMRs?

myobj_Leaf_CHG= processBismarkAln( location = list("/home/jkt_205/Downloads/Bismark-0.22.3/sorted_files/Sample1.sorted.bam","/home/jkt_205/Downloads/Bismark-0.22.3/sorted_files/Sample2.sorted.bam","/home/jkt_205/Downloads/Bismark-0.22.3/sorted_files/Sample3.sorted.bam","/home/jkt_205/Downloads/Bismark-0.22.3/sorted_files/Sample4.sorted.bam"), sample.id = list ("Sample1.sorted.bam","Sample2.sorted.bam","Sample3.sorted.bam","Sample4.sorted.bam" ), assembly = "irgps1.0", treatment= c(0,0,1,1), save.folder = "/home/jkt_205/Downloads/Bismark-0.22.3/DMR_all_stages", read.context = "CHG")


Thanks in advance.
